description: This PHP source file defines a class BuildCommands within the SuiteCRM project. The class extends Tasks and provides command-line methods for compiling themes and color schemes using SASS, primarily related to SuiteCRM's theme build process. It includes methods for building themes, handling subthemes, and managing color schemes. It also interacts with external commands like 'pscss' for CSS compilation.

classes.name: BuildCommands
classes.description: A class providing command-line interfaces for building and compiling themes and color schemes in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: buildTheme
methods.description: Compiles a specified theme's SASS files into CSS, optionally handling subthemes or multiple color schemes.

methods.name: buildSuiteP
methods.description: Convenience method to build the SuiteP theme with an optional color scheme.

methods.name: buildColorScheme
methods.description: Uses the 'pscss' external command to compile a specific color scheme's SASS file into a minified CSS file.

methods.name: locateSubTheme
methods.description: Searches a directory for subthemes (directories with a style.scss file), optionally removing existing style.css files and compiling new ones.
